policy: Only verified claims may be stated without qualification. Qualified and experimental claims must disclose their scope. Unverified claims may not be used as release or marketplace promises. Every claim declares the class of evidence behind it, and no claim may hold a status its evidence class cannot support: structural measurement over fixed inputs can never on its own support a production or quality claim.

claims.claim: Tokonomics context-processing algorithms execute in the local VS Code extension process and do not use a Tokonomics-operated backend.
claims.limitations: Optimized prompts are still sent to the user-selected upstream model provider. The Windows artifact matrix verifies installed activation and trust declarations, but provider-account and remote-host behavior remain environment-dependent. The shipped bundle embeds the tree-sitter WASM loader, which references fetch and XMLHttpRequest for browser hosts; the Extension Host takes the local filesystem branch, and the bundle audit allows those references under a narrow documented exception rather than asserting absence.

claims.claim: Tokonomics reduces AI coding input tokens by 65-88 percent.
claims.limitations: Existing measurements use a controlled synthetic corpus and do not measure the complete provider payload or independently verify downstream task success. Measured reduction is strongly task-dependent: on a single-file fixture it ranges from roughly 0 percent on requests whose required evidence is absent to roughly 98 percent on scoped single-turn requests. A controlled pilot measured 16.9 percent context reduction against the realistic baseline of attaching the single file a developer is working on, not the 65-88 percent range, which compares against forwarding a whole multi-file subsystem. The baseline chosen changes the headline number by roughly five times.

claims.claim: Tokonomics improves downstream coding task success or code accuracy.
claims.limitations: A controlled model-task pilot has now been run (14 paired tasks, real model, tools disabled so context is the only variable, validation/reports/task-evaluation.json). It measured the opposite of an uplift: baseline full-file context answered 14/14, optimized context answered 11/14, a 21.4 point regression against pre-registered non-inferiority margins of 3 to 10 points. All three losses were the model explicitly replying INSUFFICIENT CONTEXT. One of them carried 66 percent MORE tokens than the baseline and still lacked the answer, so the cause is evidence selection, not over-compression. Sample size is below the pre-registered floor of 30 per workload, so no promotion verdict follows and the claim stays unverified - but the direction of the evidence is against it, not merely absent.

claims.claim: Optimization guarantees semantic preservation or zero missing critical evidence.
claims.limitations: Checks are heuristic. Preservation, structured-content and evidence-safety gates restore the original payload on failure; a restored payload now additionally receives content-preserving noise reduction only, re-verified against the same gates. Real task-success validation is still outstanding.

claims.claim: Multi-language AST pruning is available for all advertised languages in the installed extension.
claims.limitations: Phase 1 must verify parser runtime assets and each language fixture from the packaged VSIX.

claims.claim: Prompt alignment produces provider cache discounts or verified cached tokens.
claims.limitations: Cache eligibility is not a provider-reported cache hit. The VS Code language-model API exposes no cache_control field and no per-request usage telemetry, so Tokonomics can neither request caching nor observe whether it occurred. ADR-001 closes the direct-provider path that would have made either possible. The Copilot harness reports approximately 94 percent cache hit rates on Anthropic models in agentic workloads, so the benefit is understood to be captured upstream. Tokonomics' contribution is prefix stability: historical turns render identical bytes across turns so an existing cache is not invalidated. This claim cannot be verified from within the extension and must not be stated publicly.

claims.claim: Exact and approximate response caching safely eliminates repeated provider calls.
claims.limitations: Approximate answer replay is not production-safe with the current fingerprint and is scheduled for removal or demotion in Phase 6.

claims.claim: Image rightsizing reduces the actual image payload and provider token cost.
claims.limitations: The current preserveVisualData default can leave inline images unchanged; actual outgoing payload savings must be proven in Phase 5.

claims.claim: Tokonomics is certified for worldwide or global production rollout.
claims.limitations: Legacy self-generated certification is superseded. Phase 9 artifact evidence supports a human release decision but does not establish worldwide production certification.

claims.claim: The exact inspected Tokonomics VSIX passes the configured Windows Extension Host matrix for minimum, Stable, and Insiders VS Code.
claims.limitations: Evidence is artifact-hash-bound and Windows-specific. It does not certify Cursor, VSCodium, Theia, browser, remote, container, provider-account, billing, or upstream-model behavior.

claims.claim: Project memory is local, encrypted, explicit opt-in, inspectable, bounded, and removable.
claims.limitations: Selected low-sensitivity memory items can enter requests to the user-selected upstream model provider. Installed-VSIX lifecycle review remains a human release gate.

claims.claim: Tokonomics 8.0.0 does not enable or advertise local-model assistance.
claims.limitations: Artifact governance exists for future evaluation, but no model is bundled or downloaded and local SLM output remains shadow-only.
